verses.text: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at three in the afternoon, the hour of prayer.
A man who had been unable to walk since birth was being carried there. Every day people set him down by the temple gate called Beautiful so he could ask for help from those going in.
When he saw Peter and John about to enter the temple, he asked them for money.
Peter looked straight at him, as did John, and said, “Look at us.”
The man paid close attention, expecting to get something from them.
Peter said, “I don’t have silver or gold, but I’ll give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
Peter took him by the right hand and helped him up. Immediately his feet and ankles became strong.
He jumped to his feet and began walking. Then he went into the temple with them, walking, jumping, and praising God.
Everyone saw him walking and praising God.
They recognized him as the man who used to sit begging for help at the Beautiful Gate. They were amazed and stunned by what had happened to him.
As the man who had been healed held on to Peter and John, all the people hurried over to them at the place called Solomon’s Porch, amazed.
When Peter saw this, he addressed the people: “People of Israel, why are you so amazed? Why are you staring at us as if our own power or devotion made this man walk?
“The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the God of our ancestors—has honored his servant Jesus. You handed him over and rejected him in Pilate’s presence, even though Pilate had decided to release him.
“You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be released instead.
“You killed the source of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.
“Through faith in Jesus’ name, this man—whom you see and know—was made strong. Faith in Jesus has made him completely well, as you can all see.
“Brothers and sisters, I know you and your leaders acted without understanding.
“But this is how God fulfilled what he had announced through all the prophets: the Messiah would suffer.
“So turn back to God and change direction, so your sins may be wiped away and refreshing times may come from the Lord.
“Then he will send Jesus, the Messiah appointed for you,
“whom heaven must receive until the time comes to restore everything, as God announced long ago through his holy prophets.
“Moses said, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your own people, like me. Listen to everything he tells you.
“‘Anyone who refuses to listen to that prophet will be completely removed from the people.’
“All the prophets, from Samuel onward, who spoke also announced these days.
“You are the children of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your ancestors when he told Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
“God raised up his servant and sent him to you first, to bless you by turning each of you away from your evil ways.”
